verdict.rationale: Expensify documents an Integration Server API with partner credentials and an OAuth2 flow for acting on behalf of users, so an external agent has a programmatic entry point. Its built-in AI can categorize, tag, approve and reject expenses in plain language. However, nothing shows an external agent pulling uncoded transactions, writing categorizations or policy flags back via the API, or using an MCP server. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints to list uncoded transactions, API write-back of category/GL coding and policy flags for review, any MCP server, and hands-on corroboration of an agent workflow.
